$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Format and rules: CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Dependency advisories'. Checked by scripts/advisory-gate.mjs.

entries.reason: Build time only: zip is a [build-dependencies] of utoipa-swagger-ui 6.0.0, whose build.rs unpacks the Swagger UI archive bundled inside the crate (content pinned by the Cargo.lock checksum, no AES). zip is not in the API binary and never reads a file from a user. Goes away with the axum 0.8 / utoipa upgrade.

The flaw is in deserializeErrors(), used only to hydrate server-rendered (SSR) data. web is a client-side SPA with no SSR and no hydration data. No fix in react-router 6.x.
Open redirect when an attacker controls the path given to <Link> or useNavigate. web only passes constant, in-app paths to them. No fix in react-router 6.x.
